# Aircrack-ng

`aircrack-ng` &middot; _wireless-attacks_

Audits Wi-Fi security using captured handshakes and packet files.

**High impact.** This tool can disrupt a target or a network. Confirm scope first.

## What this tool needs

- A Wi-Fi adapter that supports monitor mode. In WSL2 the physical radio is not exposed, so this needs a dedicated Linux machine or VM with USB passthrough (see docs/LIMITATIONS.md).
- A capture file (.cap) containing a handshake, if analysing offline.
- Explicit authorisation: only test Wi-Fi networks you own or are contracted to test.

## How to use it

Aircrack-ng analyses captures and recovers WPA/WEP keys. Because WSL2 cannot reach the Wi-Fi radio, use this to analyse captures made elsewhere; live monitor-mode work needs real Linux hardware.

## Examples

```console
$ aircrack-ng -w /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt capture.cap
```
